users.title: Users
users.subtitle: The portal is invitation only. You can invite and manage people with a role below yours.
users.name: Name
users.inviteIntro: The invite arrives by email (if enabled) and the link is valid for {days} days. The person chooses their own name and password.
users.roleHint: You can only give roles below yours. “Client” sees every sheet but cannot change them.
users.inviteFor: For {email}. The link is valid for {days} days and works once.
users.resetFor: For {name} ({email}). The link is valid for {hours} hours and works once.
users.linkOnce: The link is shown only now: copy it and send it to the person (WhatsApp, SMS or email).

mail.disabled: Email sending is not enabled: send the link yourself.
mail.failed: The email did not go out: send the link yourself.

users.resetText: Create a link to choose a new password (valid for {hours} hours). The current password keeps working until the link is used.
users.deactivateText: A deactivated account cannot sign in; its sheets stay.
users.reactivateText: The account will be able to sign in again with its password.
users.notManageable: You can only manage accounts with a role below yours.

error.userExists: An account with this email already exists.

audit.title: Log
audit.subtitle: Who did what and when. The log cannot be changed.
